# Best portable power stations for a CPAP

Most of these sources agree that any unit with pure sine wave output can run a CPAP. What differs is how many nights you get per charge, especially with the heated humidifier on, which roughly doubles the draw ([BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/)). Tested Watts and PowerStationBench didn't lab-test these units. Their runtimes come from spec-sheet math.

## My picks

**1. Best overall: Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 (1,024 Wh, about $700)**
- Tested Watts rates it the quietest, at about 20 dB under 200 W.
- It has a 10 ms UPS switchover, so it keeps therapy running if the grid drops while you sleep.
- It recharges from empty in about 49 minutes.
- Estimated runtime is about 2.7 nights with the humidifier off and about 1.7 with it on.
- It weighs 24.9 lb and can't be expanded.
- Sources: [Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/), [BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/) (no direct purchase link in the results; BuyerSheet lists Amazon and the official store)

**2. Best if you want whole-home backup too: EcoFlow DELTA 3 Plus (1,024 Wh, about $719)**
- It has the same capacity and UPS speed as the Anker.
- You can expand it to 5 kWh, which Tested Watts says is about 8 nights of CPAP with the humidifier on.
- It weighs 27.6 lb.
- Sources: [Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/), [BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/)

**3. Best value for 2+ nights: Bluetti AC180 (1,152 Wh, $499 at Bluetti)**
- It's estimated at about 3.1 nights with the humidifier off and 1.4 with it on.
- Buy it at [dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180). This is an affiliate link to Bluetti's official store. Dealectric reports that code **AFF5OFF** (5% off) brought the price to $474.05 when tested on Oct 21, but checkout has the final word.
- Prices vary by source. PowerStationBench shows $449 on Amazon, and one other site shows about $699.
- Weight is inconsistent too. BuyerSheet lists 35.3 lb and another site says 16.5 lb, so confirm on the product page.
- Sources: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/bluetti-discount-codes), [PowerStationBench](https://powerstationbench.com/best/power-station-for-cpap)

**4. Budget or travel (no humidifier): EcoFlow RIVER 3 Plus (286 Wh, about $279 to $299)**
- It weighs 10.4 lb and switches over in under 10 ms.
- It covers most of one night with the humidifier off (about 0.5 to 0.8 nights depending on the source), so it's tight.
- It won't last a night with the humidifier on unless you add the expansion battery.
- Sources: [Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/), [Outage Power Guide](https://outagepowerguide.com/reviews/best-power-station-for-cpap-machines/)

## Things to know
- **Jackery caution:** Jackery says on its product pages that its power stations aren't recommended for medical devices. That includes the Explorer 1000 v2, which several lists rank well. Check with your CPAP maker before choosing one ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)).
- **Pure sine wave only:** Run the CPAP from a pure sine wave outlet or your machine's own DC cord ([PowerStationBench](https://powerstationbench.com/best/power-station-for-cpap)).
- **DC cord:** Using the maker's 12V DC cord skips inverter losses and typically adds 10 to 20% runtime ([BuyerSheet](https://www.buyersheet.com/power-stations/best/cpap/)).
- **Sizing:** Plan on about 320 Wh per night without the humidifier and 520 to 720 Wh with it. The estimates differ by source, so measure your own machine with a watt meter. For two humidified nights, aim for about 1,200 Wh or more ([Tested Watts](https://testedwatts.com/2026/09/23/best-power-station-for-cpap/)).
- If you depend on CPAP therapy, ask your provider or equipment supplier about a backup plan.

If you tell me your CPAP model, whether you use the humidifier, and how many nights of backup you want, I can narrow this to one pick.
